description.value: Uprising Breads Bakery Café is a 40-plus-year community institution at the corner of Venables and Commercial Drive in East Vancouver, baking multigrain breads, pastries, and honey-sweetened goods on site every morning. The café serves a full lunch menu of homemade soups, hot savory items, and sandwiches made on fresh-baked bread, alongside espresso drinks. Both indoor and outdoor seating are available in a bright, welcoming space that locals describe as a neighborhood meeting spot.

enrichment_extras.reasoning: The website confirms an active, long-established bakery café at 1697 Venables Street with indoor and outdoor seating (also confirmed by OSM tags indoor_seating=yes, outdoor_seating=yes). The About page explicitly lists 'homemade soups and salads, hot savory items and a variety of sandwiches' confirming hot food. No evidence for bike parking, water bottle refill, washrooms, or other cycling-specific amenities appears anywhere in the website content or OSM tags.
concerns: Website shows inconsistent hours information across multiple pages, suggesting the site content has not been uniformly updated; the OSM opening hours may also be out of date.
enrichment_extras.recommended_status_reason: Well-established, actively operating bakery café with hot food and seating in a high-cycling-traffic neighborhood (Commercial Drive, East Vancouver); a practical and appealing stop for touring cyclists.

provenance.category_correction_reason: OSM tags this as shop=bakery; a bakery café is closer to a café or food stop than a grocery store, but it does sell take-home baked goods and bread products, so Groceries is a reasonable fit for the WWC context.

Hot food.detail: About page states lunchtime offerings include 'homemade soups and salads, hot savory items and a variety of sandwiches, made on our own fresh baked breads'

wow_evidence: 40-plus-year community institution at the corner of Venables and Commercial Drive
